messages.text: BL-1924 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfixes 4b0e9adb96 and 92f53eee1b: a task-mode seat's served parcel says the worktree is already on the parcel's line instead of "Execute the PAYLOAD (merge_and_process ...)", a refused take-up says to fix it and ask again instead of "Do NOT run ready_for_next.sh again", and a task-mode reverse copy is told to run done_with_current instead of to implement and forward its ticket
